name: mcp-watch-current-value
description: status_watch_once of sok mcp with equals, without a window and from a process of no surface: the server asks agent.surface, which refuses, reads windows.list, then watches the status, reads its current value and ends the watch with status.unwatch.
reason: The MCP test checks that the server returns the value unchanged. Its value is a string, while the core.screen status of the workbench is an object (packages/workbench/core-exposure.js:334), so the replay cannot give the value that the test checks.

refusal.example: process 1 is not a process of a surface: no parent process of it is a running sidecar of the application that started it for a surface
